requirements.text: The system shall allow authorised staff to create athlete profiles.
The system shall support athlete assignment to club, team, age group and position.
The system shall store athlete development history over multiple seasons.
The system shall support injury history flags without exposing medical notes to unauthorised users.
The system shall support parent/guardian association for youth athletes.
The system shall support athlete status: active, injured, unavailable, trialist, archived.
The system shall support custom attributes per organisation.
Athletes shall be able to complete a daily check-in from mobile.
Check-ins shall support configurable questions per organisation.
The system shall prevent duplicate check-ins for the same athlete and day unless staff override is enabled.
The system shall show completion status to coaches.
The system shall flag concerning responses according to configured thresholds.
The system shall support offline capture and later synchronisation.
Coaches shall be able to create session plans.
Coaches shall be able to assign sessions to athletes, groups or teams.
The system shall support session categories such as strength, tactical, endurance, speed, recovery and match.
The system shall support RPE collection after training.
The system shall compare planned load to completed load.
The system shall support microcycle planning.
The system shall support secure device connection and disconnection.
The system shall store raw device payloads for audit and reprocessing.
The system shall normalise wearable metrics into a common schema.
The system shall indicate sync status and last sync time.
The system shall handle missing data gracefully.
The system shall support device-specific permissions and consent notices.
Athletes or staff shall be able to upload photos and videos.
The system shall store media in object storage and metadata in the database.
The system shall create AI processing jobs for new media.
The system shall extract frames from videos for analysis.
The system shall generate pose landmarks where model confidence is sufficient.
The system shall avoid generating conclusions where input quality is poor.
The system shall show confidence and limitations for each analysis.
Recommendations shall include the reason for the recommendation.
Recommendations shall include confidence level.
Coaches shall be able to accept, ignore or override recommendations.
Overrides shall be logged for audit and model improvement.
Recommendations shall not be presented as medical diagnosis.
Recommendations involving minors shall support human review workflows.
The system shall generate athlete reports.
The system shall generate coach/team reports.
Reports shall be exportable to PDF.
Reports shall respect user permissions.
Reports shall include date range and source data notes.
Reports shall clearly mark AI-generated commentary.
The system shall maintain a Digital Twin with physical, performance, technical, recovery, and cognitive dimensions per athlete.
The Digital Twin shall be updated from daily check-ins, device data, and AI engine outputs.
The system shall use OAuth2/OIDC authentication with role-based authorisation and tenant isolation.
The system shall maintain audit logs for security and activity events.
The system shall support data export and deletion per data subject rights.
Youth deployments shall support parent/guardian approval and age-based access rules.
AI recommendations shall be advisory only and subject to human review; no fully automated legal/significant-effect decisions.
Each AI model shall be versioned with purpose, inputs, outputs, limitations, and monitoring plan.
Readiness engine shall produce scored readiness with contributing factors and confidence.
Recovery engine shall combine subjective and wearable recovery signals.
Injury risk engine shall produce risk indicators, not medical diagnoses.
Processing queue shall support multiple job types, priorities, and horizontal worker nodes.
API contracts shall be documented using OpenAPI with JSON payloads.
The system shall support roles: athlete, coach, parent/guardian, performance coach, physio, analyst, club management, system admin.
